notablePrerequisites: The amount of life opponents have lost this turn is equal to or greater than Rograkh's commander tax.
description:
Cast Rograkh for {0}.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Impact Tremors, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh, to deal one damage to any target.
Choose to put Rograkh in the command zone.
Repeat.
